requirement_text.REQ-002: Replace every placeholder in messages/uz.json with real Uzbek translations. Acceptance criteria: (1) every key has a non-empty value not byte-identical to ru.json's corresponding value, except standalone domain-vocabulary terms (none found in this catalog); (2) no Cyrillic characters anywhere in messages/uz.json; (3) status-label-shaped values render correctly per the design's casing convention (confirmed CSS-driven uppercase, so lowercase JSON values are correct); (4) no exclamation marks, slogans, or emoji anywhere in messages/uz.json.

task.description: Run the scope test first: this requirement has real user-visible surface (rendered Uzbek copy across all 12 sections) -- continue to the full procedure. Write docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-002.md covering REQ-002's 4 acceptance criteria with mechanically precise checks: (1) a node script comparing every ru.json/uz.json key pair, flagging any byte-identical value (expect zero, since REVIEWER already confirmed no placeholders remain); (2) a Cyrillic-regex scan over messages/uz.json (expect zero matches); (3) a grep for exclamation marks/common emoji ranges in messages/uz.json (expect zero); (4) a curl+grep check on /uz confirming the page renders with real Uzbek strings (pick 3-4 spot-check strings from different namespaces, read the actual current messages/uz.json to get real expected values) and no next-intl error markers; (5) npm run build clean. Since REQ-001b's test spec already established the pattern for checking next-intl rendering, follow a similar structure but scoped to translation-content correctness rather than mechanism correctness.
